stem.text: In the absence of air resistance, a ball thrown horizontally from a tower with velocity $v$, will land after time $T$ seconds.
If, however, air resistance is taken into account, which statement is correct?

A.text: The ball lands with a horizontal velocity less than $v$ after more than $T$ seconds.

B.text: The ball lands with a horizontal velocity less than $v$ after $T$ seconds.

C.text: The ball lands with a horizontal velocity $v$ after more than $T$ seconds.

D.text: The ball lands with a horizontal velocity $v$ after $T$ seconds.
